notes: Manifest v71 fixes the two visual regressions exposed by mobile screenshots. The visual boot barrier now remains closed through functional hydration and transcript/theme/account/layout ownership, then releases the completed chat shell in one paint instead of exposing the critical-only intermediate form. Composer collapse is now deterministic: collapsed content is display:none with a fixed 18px rail, transitions cannot translate the composer below the viewport, and expanded height measurement ignores collapsed geometry and sub-2px resize noise so repeated up/down toggles cannot accumulate drift. Runtime only; no Vercel deploy or restart required.
